description: Convert money between two of the user's own currency accounts (e.g. USD to EUR). Nothing leaves the user; to pay or send to anyone, use initiate_payment instead. Creates a request the user approves in the Moneda mobile app; the destination is the user's own account in toCurrency. Check balance with get_balance first. After calling, poll get_payment_status.

amount.description: Amount of fromCurrency to exchange, in user-facing units (e.g. '50.00')

fromCurrency.description: Currency that leaves the user's account

toCurrency.description: Currency that arrives in the user's account

name: initiate_currency_exchange
